rules.pass: At least 15% free, at least 180 days of growth left, at least 2 GiB free.
rules.warn: Under 15% free, or under 180 days at the store's growth.
rules.fail: Under 5% free, under 2 GiB free, or under 14 days at the store's growth.
rules.unknown: The data directory's free space could not be read.

advice.ok: The data disk has {free_mb} MB free ({percent}%): about {days} days at {growth_mb} MB a day, {growth}.
advice.low: The data disk has {days} days left at the current growth ({growth_mb} MB a day, {growth}); {free_mb} MB ({percent}%) is free. Every node keeps every block, so the store only grows. Add space before it fills: a full disk stops the relay. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#disk-space

rules.pass: The log, temporary and configuration directories that sit on other filesystems each have at least 1 GiB free.
rules.unknown: A mount table or a directory's free space could not be read.
rules.skipped: All three directories are on the data directory's filesystem, which disk.space covers.

advice.low: The {disk} disk has {free_mb} MiB free. Logs rotate daily; when the disk fills, the node stops writing its log. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#disk-other
advice.same-disk: The log, temporary and configuration directories share the data directory's filesystem.

rules.pass: At least 5% of the data filesystem's file entries are free, or the filesystem has no fixed count of them.
rules.unknown: The inode counts could not be read.

advice.ok: The data filesystem has {percent}% of its file entries free.
advice.no-count: The data filesystem has no fixed count of file entries (inodes), so it cannot run out of them.
advice.low: The data filesystem is running out of file entries (inodes), even though space is left: {percent}% ({free} entries) free. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#disk-inodes

rules.pass: The store sits on a local, non-rotational device.
rules.warn: A rotational disk, tmpfs, or a device whose type the kernel does not report.
rules.unknown: The mount table or the device could not be read.

advice.local: The store sits on a local, non-rotational disk.
advice.network: The store sits on a network filesystem. Its database needs a local disk: locking over a network filesystem can corrupt it. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#disk-type
advice.tmpfs: The store sits on a memory filesystem (tmpfs), which is lost at every reboot. Move the data directory to a disk. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#disk-type
advice.spinning: The store sits on a spinning disk. Block commits wait for the disk; an SSD is strongly recommended, NVMe preferred. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#disk-type
advice.unreported: The store sits on a virtual disk whose type the kernel does not report, so the doctor cannot tell whether it is an SSD. An SSD is strongly recommended, NVMe preferred. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#disk-type

rules.pass: No write of the signing record took 250 ms or more.
rules.fail: The slowest took 1,000 ms or more.
rules.unknown: The forger's log could not be read, or its level hides the lines needed.
rules.skipped: The forger does not run on this host, or its log shows no slow write while it does not run.

advice.none: No slow write of the signing record in the window.
advice.slow: Writing the signing record took {millis} ms at its slowest. The forger writes it before each block leaves, so a slow disk can make it miss its slot. The time comes from the forger's log: see whether the disk under the data directory (disk.type) or other work on this host keeps it busy. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#disk-slow-writes
